findings.passage: Representative Kane noted that several bills related to mail-in and early voting are currently pending before the Joint Committee on Election Laws, and were the subject of a public hearing less than a month ago, on May 19.

findings.passage: While there have been legitimate concerns raised about proposals to permanently extend expanded mail-in voting that must still be addressed, Representative Kane said a temporary extension is warranted, given the continued public health crisis.
findings.note: Press release from her office on H.73, a three-month extension of the mail-in voting law. It refers to unspecified concerns about permanent mail-in voting. It does not mention ID.
